applied_section_rule: Each family projects one authorized frozen applied section. [] is known empty; null is unavailable. Preserve history, source-free/Assertion-only records, saved technical/audit fields, and locks as input evidence.

modeling_assertions.description: The same seven-field projection of active authorized Dimensional-applicable Assertion Records from active Documents.
modeling_assertions.binding: Dimensional-local binding to this authorized frozen run. Follow the reference using definitions in its owning file; no global catalog or execution of Analysis.

logical_bindings.description: Compact active upstream binding projection: one selected eligible Silver Object key, its Logical Entity name, and eligible selected physical-to-Logical Attribute name pairs. Identity link only; no repeated Logical definitions, Mapping bodies, downstream dependency records, or IDs.

field_provenance.attributes[].attribute_name: Existing active ModelAttributeBindingRecord.attribute_name; parent physical Object inherited from Object Binding.

logical_bindings.selection_rule: Use recorded active logical_entity Object/Attribute Bindings for the selected Silver scope after existing Object/Attribute Mapping eligibility checks. One Object group per selected Object; include each selected eligible Attribute pair once. Do not infer matches by spelling, assume all Logical records are eligible, or turn a missing/broken expected binding into an empty/synthetic link.
logical_bindings.interpretation: Join physical Object metadata by all five actual keys. Join Logical Entities by logical_entity_name, and Logical Attributes by that Entity name plus logical_attribute_name. [] means known empty; source rows outside the selected eligible Silver scope are excluded.

naming_instructions.description: Effective Gold naming override, otherwise the existing Dimensional default: PascalCase names and key Attributes ending in Key. Preserve existing identities.

audit_columns.description: Exact required Gold audit template. Same schema_version/ordered columns layout as Logical audit settings. Each column has semantic_name, data_type, nullable, definition. Gold requires this template before model execution.

technical_columns.description: Exact required GoldTechnicalPolicy: schema_version, dimension_surrogate_key, fact_bridge_foreign_key, type_2. Do not add guessed policy fields. The current backend projects technical/surrogate/foreign-key/audit Attributes.
technical_columns.rendering: Policy strings containing {entity_name} or {role_name} stay literal JSON string values during prompt rendering. Existing backend Gold policy formatting resolves them later; no second prompt-rendering pass.

example_note: Synthetic saved input, not an AI candidate or complete production mart. Silver keys are assumed eligible through Logical Mapping/Bindings. sales_order_count is an eligible active Dimensional Assertion confirming the one-order grain and count. Saved keys/technical fields and true locks are context. Example high values do not settle a confidence threshold.
identity_note: Existing snapshot/candidate relationship key is from Entity/Attribute + to Entity/Attribute + kind + role_name (nullable). relationship_name remains in full details but does not replace kind/role. SQL uniqueness applies to active relationships; preserve existing snapshot/candidate identity rules.
source_note: Entity sources add source_role to Object/Assertion variants. Role describes a contribution, not an additional source identity. Attribute sources retain existing Attribute/Assertion variants. Relationships have no independent sources/supports.
excluded_context: No downstream read-only dependency context. Use approved compact logical_bindings for upstream identity links; preserve backend eligibility and dependency checks.
open_items: Review complete One-shot System/Instruction prompts, default inclusion, quality policy, and simple validation list together.
Then define optional reader contracts and the complete Tool-assisted prompt pair.
Preserve the current nonempty Dimensional candidate rule; empty abstention fails bounded validation, unless separately redesigned.
gold_policy_note: Preserve current pre-model validation: effective naming plus both configured technical and audit templates are required. Authors can omit a prompt variable, but cannot bypass backend policy. AI candidates cannot author technical/audit/surrogate/foreign-key Attributes; current backend projection owns those.
catalog_note: Twenty-four Dimensional-local variables are available; default prompt inclusion and tool access remain undecided.

excluded_from_catalog.source_context: Use actual Silver GDS placement and bound upstream Logical meaning; no repeated original Source Connection context included.
excluded_from_catalog.ingestion_mapping: Earlier Object-only ingestion links describe Source-to-Bronze ingestion. Approved logical_bindings links eligible Silver directly to its modeled Logical definitions.
excluded_from_catalog.object_relationship_context: Use upstream Logical relationships joined through recorded bindings; do not relabel Bronze Analysis findings as Silver physical joins.
excluded_from_catalog.raw_mapping_documents: Use binding identity links rather than full arbitrary Mapping transformation JSON for this catalog. They do not explain filters/calculations; rely on supplied Silver/Logical descriptions and Assertions, and treat missing semantics as unknown.

one_shot.reason: Sixteen full-detail/evidence/settings values; omit the eight compact directories because full records already include keys.
